title: dotbabel project config
description: Shape of a repo's `.dotbabel.json`, which drives `dotbabel project-sync` and `dotbabel-check-project-sync`. Every key is optional; omitted keys fall back to DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG in plugins/dotbabel/src/project-sync.mjs.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema.

rule_floor_source.description: Markdown file holding the canonical rule floor that instruction files are generated from.

commands_dir.description: Directory of Claude command markdown files that fan out to the other CLIs.

skills_dir.description: Directory of Claude skill directories that fan out to the other CLIs.

fan_out.description: CLIs to fan commands and skills out to. An unknown name is rejected at config load rather than skipped.

fan_out_layout.description: Whether Codex and Gemini get their own skills trees or share one. 'per-cli' writes .codex/skills/ and .gemini/skills/ as two identical trees. 'shared' writes one canonical tree at .cli/skills/ and points both CLIs at it with a directory symlink, halving the tracked entries. Copilot is unaffected. Switch back to 'per-cli' if a CLI will not follow the redirect.

gate_on_cli_presence.description: When true, skip a CLI's symlink fan-out if its binary is absent from PATH. `dotbabel-check-project-sync` honors the same setting, so it will not report the skipped CLI as drift. Pass --all to either binary to override for one run. Instruction files are always written, never gated.

cli_excluded.description: Per-CLI exclusion list. Maps a CLI name to command basenames (without .md) and skill ids that must not fan out to it, for commands that describe a Claude-only flow. An excluded entry already on disk is removed on the next sync; `dotbabel-check-project-sync` reports it as drift until then. Under fan_out_layout 'shared' an exclusion for codex or gemini applies to both, since they read one tree.

cli_substitutions.description: Per-CLI text substitutions applied while rendering instruction files.

targets.description: Instruction files to generate from the rule floor.

relativeOutputPath.description: Repo-relative path of the generated instruction file.

substitutionKey.description: Key into cli_substitutions used when rendering this target.
